name: Heather Bunting
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a warm and compassionate counsellor who is interested in peoples' lives and concerns. I understand that being truly heard is rare and my goal is to support those I see without judgement. For many years as both a parent and counsellor, I have been striving to listen actively, to get to the heart of unhappiness or desire for change, and through a variety of methods, work towards unlocking potential.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Cara Crossan
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Kim Billington
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Kim provides online and in-person group and individual supervision for counsellors working with a variety of client issues and ages. Kim also provides clinical individual and group supervision for agencies and schools. Kim offers child and family, and individual counselling: online, telehealth and in-person in Moorabbin.
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Sarah Cotillon
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am an experienced Counsellor providing therapy services to adults, adolescents and couples. I hold a Master in Counselling degree from Monash University, am fully trained in EMDR Therapy with the EMDR Institute of Australia & New Zealand and have completed level 1 training in Gottman Method Couples Therapy. I use a range of therapeutic interventions; Person-Centred, Family Systems, Couples Therapy, Existential, EMDR Therapy, Acceptance & Commitment Therapy and Solution Focused Therapy.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Amy Islip
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: We all want the happiness and fulfilment that comes from having more love and connection in our lives. To experience more love and connection you need the right skills and knowledge. At Think Better, our mission is to teach individuals and couples the knowledge and skills to create happy, healthy relationships – from the inside, out.
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Stephen Pate
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I’m a qualified psychotherapist and counellor based on the Mornington Peninsula, with a background in Chinese medicine and over a decade of experience supporting clients holistically. I work with adults, teens, and athletes experiencing anxiety, life transitions, chronic pain, stress, and emotional overwhelm. My approach is person-centred, strengths-based, and grounded in compassion.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery
